The '''Taris Civil Authority gunship''' was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around [[3964 BBY]] by the [[Taris Civil Authority]]. One was used in the attempted capture of [[Zayne Carrick]] for his alleged involvement in the [[Padawan Massacre]]. It could carry at least 10 people aboard and was equipped with a public-address system. The gunship was not [[Realspace/Legends|spaceworthy]] so, in the event of fugitives escaping to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the Taris Civil Authority's [[Taris Civil Authority police cruiser|police cruisers]] would be used instead.

==Behind the scenes==
The Taris Civil Authority gunship appeared in [[Knights of the Old Republic 3|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 3]] and was penciled by [[Brian Ching]].
